component.name: Termix
component.summary: Self-hosted SSH and remote desktop management

description.p: This is a community package of Termix, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified and uses the same app id as upstream's own Flatpak build.
Termix is an open-source, self-hosted server management platform and a free alternative to Termius. It brings your servers together in one interface.

ul.li: SSH terminals with split views, tabs and saved hosts.
Remote desktop over RDP, VNC and Telnet.
SSH tunnels and a remote file manager.
Server statistics, Docker management and more through plugins.
Optional sync with a self-hosted Termix server.

description.p: Permissions follow upstream's own Flatpak build: network, audio, your home directory (for SSH keys and file transfers), the host's ssh-agent and the keyring.
The local terminal runs a shell inside the sandbox, not on your host. Serial consoles need device access, which is not granted by default: flatpak override --user --device=all com.karmaa.termix.
